title: Playboy Magazine December 1987 Gala Christmas Brigitte Nielsen - Damaged
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, December 1987 -- Gala Christmas Issue: Brigitte Nielsen/Stallone, "The Lost Chapter of Catch-22," Jessica Hahn Part Two, Gore Vidal interview.

Condition/defect disclosure: this copy has a torn/missing corner chunk on the back cover (see photos) -- genuine damage, priced accordingly. Please review all photos carefully before purchasing.
